tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.45; also called Lebana at Neh.7.48;
§ Lebanah or Lebana = "moon-white"
head of a family of exiles who returned with Zerubbabel

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Lebana or Lebanah, one of the Nethinim
strongs_1890.derivation: or לְבָנָה; the same as H3842 (לְבָנָה);
